findings.summary: ball/cage: synthetic-only, uncalibrated amplitude. The ball and cage classes were trained on simulated faults whose mechanical amplitude (CALIBRATED_MECHANICAL_SEVERITY in datagen/scenario.py) is a placeholder: KAt has no clean single-defect code for these faults, so it cannot be calibrated without real data.
2048-sample (205 ms) windows: start-up transient accuracy 0.60; steady state 1.00 at 150 rad/s, 0.96 at 100 rad/s (cage recall 1.00).
Trained and evaluated on simulated data only. Recorded test accuracy 0.903; no real-machine validation exists.

AI-N27 (open): 790 of its 4440 training windows (17.8 %; cage 391, ball 223, outer_race 105, inner_race 71, normal 0) contain a non-physical simulator artifact (S-21: the one-quadrant converter applies the full supply on negative current, and the speed rises above its reference), only in fault classes, mostly at 80-125 rad/s and high severity. The model and its promotion are unchanged; its effect on the predictions is being measured (ai_n27_impact).
